facts.fact: The legend names Plaza Gertrudis Bocanegra, Plaza Vasco de Quiroga, Casa de los Once Patios, El Sagrario and Basilica de Nuestra Señora de la Salud. All five stops are in the historic-centre map; printed numbering is not used because the legend and schematic are inconsistent for the Basilica.

The schematic places Gertrudis Bocanegra north of Vasco de Quiroga, the Basilica northeast of the main square, and Sagrario/Once Patios in the eastern/southeastern cluster. This supports an editorial walking sequence, without a precise scale or guaranteed time.
facts.location: PDF page 1, visually read title and city-centre schematic with north arrow; relative positions are interpreted from the map, not a prose quotation
